prompt: Why does the woman think the team can consider the lower quote without delivery?
promptZh: 女子為什麼認為較低的報價即使不含運送也可考慮？

options.text: The vendor has offered to deliver it later at no charge.
options.zh: 廠商願意稍後免費運送。
options.whyZh: 報價不含運送，也沒提出免費補送。

options.text: An organizer can lend them a booth already on site.
options.zh: 主辦人可借他們一座已在現場的攤位。
options.whyZh: 沒有現場借用的提案；這款攤位可自行取貨。

options.text: The team can pick up the booth themselves.
options.zh: 團隊可以自己去取攤位設備。
options.whyZh: 他們能去工坊取貨，因此運送是可省略的服務。

options.text: The delivery fee is already part of the other quote.
options.zh: 另一份報價已包含這筆運費。
options.whyZh: 女子沒說另一份報價能代付這款攤位的運費。

explanationZh: 他們能去工坊取貨，因此運送是可省略的服務。
evidence: The second booth quote is lower. It doesn’t include delivery, but our team can collect the booth from the workshop.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The second booth quote is lower. It doesn’t include delivery, but our team can collect the booth from the workshop.
